thread:
julie_support: @ryan getting a BrightPay escalation — multiple customers seeing 502s and long p95 timeouts from hosted inference since ~03:24 UTC. customer attached client errors and a couple request ids.
brightpay_customer: fyi we started a token rotation at 03:18 and immediately saw retries. sample req ids: req=bp-7f3a, bp-7f3b, bp-7f3e. failures are intermittent 502 / timeout waiting for response.
julie_support: repro curl they gave:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <OLD_TOKEN>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'```client shows `timeout waiting for response` after many 5xx.
ops-bot: [ingress-alert] hosted/gateway 5xx rate +600% between 03:20-03:30 UTC; avg queue_depth 92% and continuous-batcher backlog spiked.
ryan_oncall: looked at traces — lots of 401s from token-exchange attempts, client retries -> immediate flood. those retries kept enqueuing requests into gateway, causing queue depth to hit configured limit and then we started returning 502/early reject. continuous-batcher backlog never had chance to drain.
liz_enginfra: can you paste gateway logs (auth and enqueue lines)? Also note: we ran a KMS key-roll job at 03:18 in infra — could have invalidated cached service tokens briefly.
steve_product: BrightPay also reported billing webhook failing around 03:19 which retried auth -> could be the origin of the retry storm.
julie_support: gateway sample log:```[03:21:05 UTC] auth: token exchange failed tenant=brightpay err="401 unauthorized"
[03:21:05 UTC] enqueue: tenant=brightpay size=1 queue_depth=945/1000
[03:21:06 UTC] enqueue: tenant=brightpay err="queue depth exceeded"
[03:21:07 UTC] response: tenant=brightpay status=502 latency=0.000s```
ryan_oncall: repro steps (customer + our local): 1) rotate service token 2) restart client 3) fire ~300 concurrent requests -> gateway q depth hits limit, continuous-batcher backlog increases and p95 tail timeouts appear across other tenants as well. I reproduced with small load test.
liz_enginfra: immediate mitigation applied: scaled hosted-gateway from 3 -> 6 replicas and bumped queue_limit for hosted pool from 1000 -> 1500 for 15m window. also applied temporary tenant-isolation rule for brightpay to cap in-flight to 200.
deploy-bot: scaled deployment hosted-gateway replicas 3 -> 6 (rollout id: r-20260318-01)
ops-bot: policy applied: tenant-rate-limit brightpay = 200rps, tenant-queue-max-inflight = 200 (temporary).
ryan_oncall: recommended action for customer: rotate token fully (ensure no old tokens in rotation window), add exponential backoff + jitter on client retries, reduce concurrency while rotation completes. we've also patched gateway to log auth-rotation spike counts to metrics.
brightpay_customer: updated client to backoff + rotated token; errors dropped immediately. still seeing a few tail timeouts but p95 improved from ~1.8s to ~310ms. thanks for fast response.
steve_product: follow-ups: add runbook entry to detect auth-rotation-induced retry storms, and implement auto-isolation when tenant auth-error rate spikes above threshold. also coordinate KMS rotation window with tenant ops.
julie_support: marking resolved-for-now, monitoring for 60m. will open a short postmortem if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
